lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: The Slime King! It has 80 health and slams every tower next to it for 10.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Keep your towers apart and hit it from afar. If it reaches the castle, we are lost.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Welcome, {player}. Slimes are coming down that road, and the castle is what they want.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Place your Archer near the castle. Click its piece in the tray at the bottom, and the tiles you can build on light up; pick one.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: The card on the right shows the selected tower: its name and health, its stats and statuses. Its abilities wait on the bar above your hand; the ring around each shows how many turns it must wait.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Good. Click End Turn at the bottom right to end the round (or press {key:EndRound}). Then the enemies move.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: A Slime! It is too far to shoot. Click your Archer, click Tower Walk on the bar above your hand, then a tile on the way to the Slime.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Your Archer shoots 2 tiles. Click End Turn until the Slime comes that close.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: It is in range! Click your Archer, click Shoot, then click the Slime.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Each round: shoot, then click End Turn. Keep it up until the Slime is gone.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Well done! More are coming: keep clicking End Turn until they are here.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: A Slime and a fast Runner now. When one is in range, {click:QuickCast} Shoot: your Archer picks a target by itself.

lines.speaker: Princess
lines.text: Hold them off until the wave is over.
